learning_outcomes.text: The student is able to design a CNC machining programme including the selection of tools and cutting parameters.
The student is able to estimate costs of manufacturing with the use of CNC machine tools.
The student has knowledge of the basic programming languages for CNC machine tools. He/she has knowledge about the basics of creating machining programmes.

The student has knowledge of how to prepare a semi-finished product for the machining process on CNC machine tools. He/she has knowledge about the types of subcontracting services available to prepare a semi-finished product of sufficient quality.

syllabus_topics: Basic CNC controllers and their programming languages
Design of a CNC machining programme
Basic programming in ISO code (G code)
Use of logical functions in CNC programming
CNC programming on Heidenhain and ISO-God control for turning and milling processes
Execution of a machining programme for a mechanical component
assessment_rules: A passing threshold of 60.0% is required for the Project, Laboratory, and Lecture components.
